question_stem:
A student designs a circuit incorporating an operational amplifier (op-amp) as shown in Fig. 8.1.

{{figure:figure_8_1}}

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: On Fig. 8.1, draw a circle around the output device.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: State the purpose of this circuit.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.part_stem: The resistors X and Y each have resistance $R$. When conducting, the LED labelled B emits blue light and the LED labelled G emits green light.
parts.text: State whether blue light or green light is emitted when the resistance of component C is greater than the resistance $R_V$ of the variable resistor. Explain your answer.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State and explain what is observed as the resistance of component C is reduced.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Suggest the function of the variable resistor.
